name: Mosaic Item Status Pill
describe: Per-item KOT status badge: px6 py2 r4, 12/600, 1px border; default shows the four states side by side.

Beside each KOT item quantity; state progresses Queued, Preparing, Ready, Served. Modes: light and rtl only; dark is not applicable (mosaic/src/index.css defines one light palette (:root only) and no dark: classes or .dark overrides, so the KDS has no dark theme).
